title: Device-independent Quantum Key Distribution in the commuting operator framework
summary: Device-independent quantum key distribution (DIQKD) is arguably the gold standard for secure quantum communication, as it aims to rely only on observed input-output statistics of an uncharacterized device which is only assumption to obey the laws of quantum physics. A corresponding security analysis hence demands a description of a quantum experiment from a most general perspective.
